title: Gradient Text Generator
description: Make gradient-filled text with background-clip — pick colors and angle, preview live, copy the CSS snippet.
howto: Pick two (or three) gradient colors and an angle.
Copy the CSS — it uses background: linear-gradient + background-clip: text.

faqs.q: How does gradient text work in CSS?
faqs.a: The gradient is painted as the element background, then background-clip: text with transparent color cuts the background to the glyph shapes.

faqs.q: Does it work in all browsers?
faqs.a: All modern browsers support background-clip: text (with -webkit- prefix for Safari/Chrome). The generated snippet includes both.
Yes — it is real text, not an image, so assistive tech reads it normally. Keep contrast reasonable for low-vision users.
